question.text: An investor withdraws Rs. 30 lakh from a PMS in year 2. Exit load is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Year 2 exit load = 2%. Rs. 30 lakh × 2% = Rs. 60,000. The Trap: Year 1 = 3%; Year 3 = 1%; after Year 4 = 0%. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document exit load schedule upfront in the DD to prevent client surprises.
